title: Throwable Ladders
description: Now you can throw ladders to quick place it on the walls
body:
[![0](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5df054f9ecf209c3f6a62629613313f743feeccf.png)](https://discord.gg/QApmFh8BHW)

![0](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/17ebe1d0017151c970735893e28e93f034a8f7c8.png)

This simple datapack adds the ability to throw ladders at walls to quickly set them up. To do this, simply press **Q** while jumping

In addition to the main functionality, the datapack adds the ability to break the line of ladders if the player holds **Shift**
